content.text: Everyone, can you help me see if this box is still usable?
@小白 This crack looks pretty serious, are you sure it can still hold up?
@小白 This is already cracked like this. How embarrassing it would be if the luggage falls out later!
@小白 It's better to buy a reliable suitcase, so you don't end up causing delays.
Look at this! Buy a better aluminum case, sturdy and good-looking.
@Vicky This is indeed nice, but it seems a bit expensive, doesn't it?
Outrageously expensive! The price alone made me back off.
@小白 Haha, I get you! Don’t worry, even a box that costs a few dozen yuan can work!
@Fat Tiger, stop recommending those cheap products; the quality is simply incomparable.
Actually, you don't need to spend too much on a suitcase, but don't go for the cheapest either—it's not worth the risk!
Focus on practicality. Get something reliable, not just cheap.
To sum up, we haven't reached a consensus on the box issue yet!
It seems I still need to consider other options; I can't just focus on the price!
Look at this box, it's very cheap, but I'm not sure about the quality.
@小白 This cheap suitcase isn't very reliable; it might break down before long.
@Vicky I think this price is acceptable, since it's just for temporary use anyway.
I tried these six colors of ski jackets, which one makes me look fairer?
@Mia I think the color of the third one in the first row is the most beautiful, quite eye-catching.
@Mia I agree with Dawei's point, that color really does make the skin look fairer.
Everyone, take a look at this windbreaker—it's durable and long-lasting.
@David This outfit really looks like a delivery uniform, the color and cut are too plain.
@David The quality of the clothes might be good, but the design isn't really fashionable.
@David This type of clothing is very practical for outdoor activities; there's no need to be too concerned about its appearance.
Regarding the box, it might indeed be necessary to consider the balance between quality and price.
It seems I still need to pick a ski suit that makes me look fairer; a windbreaker is out of the question.
After everyone has prepared their gear, don't forget the medication list.
Everyone, what do you think? Can I still use this suitcase? It doesn't seem too badly damaged.
@小白 I don't think it's a good idea. If the corner is cracked, it might get worse during check-in when traveling, and it could even break completely.
If you ask me, just buy a cheap one so you won't feel bad if it breaks. How about the budget-friendly alternative I shared from Pinduoduo last time?
@Fat Tiger, those cheap suitcases that cost just a few dozen bucks are totally unreliable. They fall apart after just one check-in, so it's really not worth it.
@小白 I think you should get a better suitcase, otherwise it would be really troublesome if it breaks during the trip.
If you ask me, practicality should be the priority when buying things. Why are you still hesitating after all this time?
When it comes to practicality, the plush lining of these snow boots is incredibly warm, making them a must-have for winter outings!
@Vicky This does look quite warm, perfect for the cold weather up north. But might it seem a bit bulky?
I just impulsively added these boots to my shopping cart, haha.
@Xiaobai, you're really quick, but these shoes are indeed quite suitable for winter.
Since we're all talking about equipment, I'll take the opportunity to share a list of medications. Let me know if anything is missing and feel free to add to it.
@Old Zhang This list is quite detailed, but don't forget to bring band-aids. Scratches and such are quite common.
@Old Zhang, don't forget the lip balm! Lips tend to get chapped in winter, and it's really uncomfortable without it.
Everyone, take a look. Does this hat match my style?
@小白 Wow, this hat is really cute! But maybe you should pair it with a slightly brighter jacket?
@小白 Nice hat, but you still need to consider staying warm, not just the looks.
@小白 I agree with Mia, the hat is nice, but the pairing does need attention. Is it for skiing gear or everyday use now?
I wore it while skiing, and it felt quite fitting for the atmosphere. I saw Mia also took a selfie wearing a hat, and it looked really nice too.
@小白 The hat is fine, but the issue with your suitcase hasn't been resolved yet! Can it still be used with a corner broken?
@Fat Tiger, the box is still usable, but I'm worried it might crack again during transit. Is the quality of the Pinduoduo box you recommended really reliable?
@小白 I think cheap is fine; after all, it won't be used many times. It's not worth spending thousands on an aluminum alloy case, right?
@Fat Tiger The quality of Pinduoduo is really not good. I've already said that you can't skimp too much on equipment, especially on things like boxes that bear weight.
When it comes to practicality, take a look at these anti-slip crampons—they're a must-have for hiking or skiing!

When it comes to practicality, take a look at these anti-slip crampons. They are essential for hiking or skiing. However, there are several types of crampons. For simple walks on snowy terrain, rubber crampons are sufficient—they are affordable and lightweight. If you're tackling icy mountain trails, stainless steel crampons are necessary, with longer and sharper teeth for stronger grip. Choosing the right crampons based on the terrain ensures safety.
@David This does look practical, but would it be uncomfortable to wear while walking?
I just tried it, and it seems like the crampons aren't installed correctly, right? @大伟 Did I put them on backwards?
@小白 Yes, you installed it incorrectly. The crampons need to fit snugly against the sole of your shoes; otherwise, you'll feel unstable while walking. Let me show you the correct way to install them.
Everyone, take a look at this equipment procurement summary table. Is there anything missing?
@小白 It seems like you still haven't decided which box to use here!
Yeah, Xiao Bai, is that old suitcase of yours still usable?
I think it's better to buy a new one. Safety is the most important thing.
@小白 Have you seen the cheap boxes on Pinduoduo? What if the quality is actually good?
Don't forget the medication list, everyone. Safety first.
@Fat Tiger I've seen it, and some of the reviews aren't very good.
How about considering a mid-range suitcase? The price is reasonable and the quality is also good.
Yes, mid-range ones might be more reliable, at least they won't be as unstable as those from Pinduoduo.
Well, a mid-range suitcase is a good choice, the key is that it needs to be durable.
So, Xiao Bai, how are you planning to choose?
Then I'll take another look at the mid-range options, following everyone's suggestions.
Let me know once you've decided, and I'll update the summary table.
Alright, then we'll wait for Xiao Bai to make the decision!
Looking forward to your choice, Xiao Bai!

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 小白展示旧箱子的裂纹，引发大家对箱子是否还能用的讨论。Vicky推荐高端铝箱子，价格却让小白劝退。胖虎尝试推荐廉价箱子，但遭到Vicky否定。箱子选择的问题尚未达成一致。
(第2段摘要): 小白提出廉价箱子质量问题，米娅寻找显白滑雪服，大伟推荐耐用冲锋衣，围绕装备质量和外观展开讨论。
(第3段摘要): 大家继续讨论小白旧箱子是否还能用，并在价格和质量之间寻找平衡。Vicky推荐保暖雪地靴后，米娅提出其可能笨重，但小白已经将靴子加入购物车。一张药品清单被分享，引发了关于必备物品的补充建议。
(第4段摘要): 对话围绕帽子的搭配、箱子的选择和防滑冰爪的使用展开。小白的旧箱子问题仍未解决，大家对价格与质量的平衡点产生分歧。
(第5段摘要): 小白展示装备采购汇总表，大家继续讨论旧箱子是否能用，建议选择中端箱子。最后，小白决定再考虑中端选择。
